notes.title: Postponing the release date
notes.notes:
I welcome everyone, friends!

This year has turned out to be difficult for everyone, as well as for me. I work on the game practically alone and I also solve a bunch of family and life problems. I don't have enough time to release the game this year, as I wanted.

But development continues and never stands still! At the moment I am in the final stages of processing the game, "gluing" the mechanics of the game into a coherent whole.

[b]The game is expected to be released in February 2021.[/b]

Thanks to everyone, friends, who support me on Twitter, as well as to all those who are not indifferent who added the game to the wishlist ;)


See you soon!
Max.

notes.title: Haunted by Evil
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/e232c7c8801236d158399d72babbc23cbf10a478.png[/img]

[h2]Greetings everyone![/h2]

My name is Max. I am the founder of [b]BKE Games Studio[/b] and the sole developer of the game [b]Haunted by Evil[/b] :)
Only a couple of people are officially listed in the studio. They help me from time to time with the development of art and pixel art. Simply say, in the studio, besides me, there are two artists who make this game colorful and scary. ːsteammockingː

[h3]«Haunted by Evil» — is a psycho-intellectual horror about a man who fights nightmares in reality using his madness and weapons.[/h3]

The story revolves around Patrick, a young guy working in the IT field. Patrick is a man with a difficult past that haunts him. It all starts with the fact that Patrick is tormented by nightmares that are very similar to real ones. On top of that, a missing of peoples incident from many years ago again occurs in the fictional city of Summerveil, and reaches the office where Patrick works. A horror game with unusual mechanics and atypical gameplay, which you have not yet met in horror games, are waiting for you!

The demo of the game will tell you how Patrick's story began in these nightmarish events of the game... ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Devlog: New item menu
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/cd4e290dbc7c12f0e363d7423f25d5a781204c08.jpg[/img]


Greetings!

Finally, I've remade the boring menu into a more play-style one. Now the menu combines several functions at once. In the early version, it was divided into two large sections, separate from each other: weapons and other items. Now all this is combined in a new and convenient single interface!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/509a6160271d8dfe59e693f9e7c7c86232f15288.jpg[/img]

It took me a month and a half to develop such a menu. I slept very little because I fixed a lot of bugs. Eventually I implemented it into the game. And most importantly, it fits perfectly with the style of play.

Additional windows have also appeared for interacting with items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/995cdbbd41d0eb9c1f102b566ba5839c521a4b10.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/c898a24fa580941f9cecb0616a64d2765e7687e7.jpg[/img]


In a future demo, which I am going to release shortly, you can already try out the initial fragment of the game and the menu itself in action. The next demo version will no longer be closed and will be available to everyone!

I also remind you that [b]Haunted by Evil is participating in The Autumn Games Festival on Steam![/b] Everyone will be able to play the demo version of the game and ask me their questions about the game and its development :)

Until next time! ːsteammockingː
Max

notes.title: Devlog: Item icon redesign
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/d5803820f708449cc7381b0f3b6a16f93e6f4d23.png[/img]

Greetings!

I reviewed the drawn pixel icons of items, and decided to rework them. These icons will be used in the new item menu, which I have almost completed and implemented into the game (this will be a separate news article).

In general, almost all the main objects in the game were redesigned and redrawn, but I still draw something. The screenshot shows how the items are getting better in quality:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/b2900b6d4c59668a3cf1d3750853e60fa9db75c9.jpg[/img]

All redrawn items will serve as icons for the new menu.
Wait for further updates :)

See you soon! ːsteammockingː
Max.

notes.title: Devlog: Developing and adding weapons
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/aefb9cd7128495bdf7b6b8b1067f4350c65627b6.jpg[/img]


I'm glad to inform you that new weapon has been added:
1) .45 Pistol
2) М4
3) Shotgun

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/f7422c0e9b87875c92d0fb36460478e3e11b2d15.png[/img]

Weapon damage was rebalanced:
[list]
[*] Axe damage was reduced to [i]-5%[/i]
[*] .45 Pistol started inflicting more damage [i]+10%[/i]
[*] M4 damage was reduced to [i]-15%[/i] (as it was more effective in auto fire mode that the shotgun)
[*] Shotgun became more effective in close combat [i]+35%[/i] damage, but the fire length was reduced from [i]7[/i] to [i]4[/i] tiles.
[/list]

I plan to add explosive weapon such as grenades in the future. A new kind of powerful gun will be also added. It will be possible to craft grenades and ammo from collected materials. But I'll tell you about crafting in the following updates. ːsteamhappyː

See you soon!
[i]Max Eliseev[/i].

notes.title: Haunted by Evil on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/20eaa48044487ea89473a82f88b0af7419f2beff.jpg[/img]


The game has finally been published on [b]Steam[/b]!

It is a great joy to introduce you this game! I work on it every day, make improvements and add something new.

Now there is still quite a lot of work on the game. [i]The game itself will consist of 5 episodes, the first of which will tentatively be released in October this year.[/i] I mostly work on the game for the most part. Only a couple of people help me: an artist who draws character art for the game, including creating this cover for the game, and a pixel-art artist who helps draw some objects and monsters for the game.

In the news, I will inform you of all changes in the game and progress in development!
I would also be happy if you [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] ;)

See you soon!
[i]Max Eliseev[/i].
